answer: An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the horizon index resolves every citation against the marble checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the orchard audit keeps the resolved set. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 7 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
